content: Long-running pipeline over HTTP: never synchronous (web model not designed for >few min open requests; proxy/LB timeouts kill it). Standard = POST kicks off async work + returns job id immediately, GET /jobs/{id} polls status (pending/running/succeeded/failed), optional cancel endpoint. Status via durable registry (file or DB table, not in-memory only - survives restart). Single-flight: check-before-start that pipeline not already running (distinguish concurrent invocations; same-job overlap guard); idempotency key to dedupe retried POSTs. On Windows: start_new_session=True is silently ignored - must pass creationflags CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NO_WINDOW to survive console close without console flash; kill tree via taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F since proc.kill() misses grandchildren.
